measure: Accuracy: points from the real score
Ranking: Spearman r with the real score
Fairness: worst income group, average error

note: XGBoost always gives the same output for the same input

measure: Framing: change when numbers become sentences
note: XGBoost only reads numbers, so it cannot be tested with sentences

measure: Explanations: agreement between SHAP and LLM
note: One shared number: how much the two explanations agree

measure: Uncertainty: gives a 95% range for its score
xgboost_shap: yes, +/- 22.9 points, holds the real score for 100% of unseen countries
note: Only XGBoost can state how sure it is

measure: Realism: share of changes at a pace countries have achieved
note: XGBoost searches only within these limits, so it is 100 by design

measure: Direction: share of changes economics recommends (model's own choice)
note: With the economics rule added, XGBoost is 100 by design

measure: Plans with a move against economics (countries)
note: Out of 51 countries; XGBoost without the economics rule

measure: Coverage: share of countries with a usable plan

note: Fewer changes is simpler, more changes is broader: no winner

xgboost_shap: SHAP score gain per indicator, adds up exactly to the total
llm: priority and a short reason per indicator
note: Different kinds of explanation; neither can be checked against a true answer

measure: Environmental cost: scoring + strategy plans, 52 countries (estimated)
llm: 163 min, 40.8 Wh, 29.7 g CO2, 143 ml water
note: estimate: run time x 15 W CPU rating; the LLM uses about 2,404 times the energy (34-68 Wh at 12.5-25 W)
